findings.description: This creates an IAM access key for the user, introducing persistent credentials that can be compromised and remain valid until manually rotated or revoked. Prefer federated role access with temporary credentials where possible.

The policy grants wildcard actions across EC2, S3, Lambda, and CloudWatch against every resource. This violates least privilege and enables broad access to infrastructure and data, including potentially sensitive S3 objects and Lambda functions.
